title: Fantasy River Siege
description: A vibrant surreal fantasy scene shows two pink-sailed boats labeled 'PIRATE' and 'WITCH' carrying green-skinned and pink-haired figures navigating a river of glowing yellow spirals. In the foreground a woman in blue kneels on a stone dock operating a glowing blue device, while a demonic horned castle with pink windows looms in the background under a dual-sun sky with a floating black sigil and magical effects.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal fantasy painting of a magical river with glowing yellow spiral patterns. Two pink pirate-style boats sail on the water, one carrying a green-skinned witch and another figure. In the foreground a woman in a blue crop top and pants kneels on a stone dock operating a glowing blue magical device. A large demonic horned dragon-like castle with glowing pink windows stands in the background. A wizard in a pink robe casts purple lightning. Two suns, one yellow and one green, float in a swirling orange and purple sky alongside a large black magical sigil. Pink butterflies and sparkles fill the air.
